mission_04: Excellent! You have implemented the core components of a Transformer model adapted for time series forecasting. The positional encoding injects temporal order information into the model using sinusoidal functions of different frequencies, allowing the attention mechanism to leverage position-aware representations. The scaled dot-product attention computes relevance scores between all pairs of time steps, enabling the model to identify which historical observations are most informative for prediction. Multi-head attention allows the model to simultaneously attend to patterns at different temporal scales, such as short-term fluctuations and long-term trends. This architecture has become the foundation for state-of-the-art time series models like Informer, Autoformer, and PatchTST.
